name: Bhagavad Gita 13.27
text:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
meaning: One who sees the supreme lord abiding equally in all beings, the imperishable within the perishing, truly sees.
purpose: Seeing the imperishable reality in all beings.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
